name: How much does professional siding preparation add to the total cost of siding installation?

mainEntity.name: How much does professional siding preparation add to the total cost of siding installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of siding preparation varies widely depending on the condition of the existing structure and the extent of work required. It typically includes labor for old siding removal, sheathing repair, surface cleaning, and weather barrier installation. If significant rot, structural repairs, or lead paint remediation are necessary, these costs will increase. Generally, preparation can add anywhere from 10% to 30% or more to the overall siding project budget. A detailed estimate from your contractor will clarify these costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Siding preparation costs vary based on necessary repairs, potentially adding 10-30% to the total installation budget.
